lastCompletedStory.title: Extend blocked-marker schema with dedup-key + consecutive-count logic

nextStoryContext: US-002 wires advanceBlockedMarker into host.ts's writeImplementBlockedMarkerFn: read the existing marker via readImplementBlockedMarker(join(claudeDir, IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME)), compute prdHash as sha256 over prdPath's file bytes (Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256'), degrade gracefully to a stable reset-key value on an unreadable/absent prd.json, never throw), then call advanceBlockedMarker(prev, { issueId, story, reason, writtenAt }, prdHash) and persist the result. Delete the two US-001 placeholder lines in host.ts (consecutiveCount: 1, keyHash: '' -- both are explicitly commented as 'replaced by US-002'). AdvanceBlockedMarkerParams requires writtenAt (the caller stamps it, e.g. new Date().toISOString()); the same value is reused for haltedAt when escalation trips, so pass it once and let advanceBlockedMarker use it for both. Threshold defaults to 3 and does not need to be passed explicitly unless a story wants a different value.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256') constructor, .update(string), .digest('hex') synchronous hex-string API confirmed current; matches the existing suggestion-followups.ts usage this story mirrors.
